Camila / Marissa — quick read below. I went through the tracked redlines and flagged the items that need discussion: 

- Data-retention / deletion: we can agree to a defined retention window for pilot data (30–90 days) but cant accept open-ended deletion obligations that conflict with our operational backups. Ask: can they agree to 60 days with defined scope?
- Indemnity: their request to completely remove our limitation of liability is a no-go. Propose a mutual carve for third-party IP claims and otherwise preserve our standard cap.
- SOC2 / audit evidence: we can provide SOC2 report summary and on-request audit logs; for an on-site audit we'll need a scoped NDA & scheduling lead time.

I can draft a redline response with tracked changes — Ill aim to have a counter by Monday (2026-10-26). If procurement insists on live negotiation, propose a 30-min call with counsel + procurement.

Rishi Malhotra
